meta.description: Uses symptoms to focus troubleshooting on DNS resolution.

question.text: Users can reach a server by IP address but not by its hostname. Which two checks are most relevant to troubleshooting this symptom? Select two.
options: Verify that the client is using a reachable, correct DNS resolver
Query DNS to see whether the hostname has the expected record
Replace every switch before checking name resolution
Change the Ethernet duplex setting as the first step
correctAnswers: Verify that the client is using a reachable, correct DNS resolver
Query DNS to see whether the hostname has the expected record
